ability.name: BANG BANG BANGERS
ability.desc:
Passive: Gain a Chakram every 4 attacks, up to 15. Attacks deal 7/10/200 bonus physical damage for every Chakram equipped. After collecting 15, gain 30%/500%/1000% Attack Damage and infinite range.

Active: Fire bolts at the 3 nearest enemies that deal 340/510/3300 physical damage, then split into 16 bolts that deal 51/76.5/3300 physical damage to enemies they pass through. Gain 0.75 Attack Speed for 4 seconds.

Heartsteel Upgrade: Start combat with 5 Chakrams equipped.

ability.name: Big Business
ability.desc:
Passive: While Dr. Mundo has 3000 max Health or more, he becomes Pumped Up, gaining 20%/300%/300% max Health and causing attacks to deal an additional 89/114/2300 magic damage.

Active: Restore 480/530/4300 Health over 5/3.5/3.5 seconds and deal 25/29/102 magic damage each second to all enemies within 2/5/5 hexes.

ability.name: Glimmer in the Night
ability.desc:
Passive: Attacks deal 60/90/1000 bonus magic damage to the target and 22/35/500 to other enemies in a cone. Dash to new targets.

Active: Summon a massive pair of scissors over the battlefield. After a short delay, snip a horizontal line on the target, dealing 90/135/4000 magic damage to all enemies hit + 830/1300/8000 split between them. If 1 or fewer enemies are hit, refund 50/200/200 Mana.

ability.name: Hymn of the Heaven's Gale
ability.desc:
Fire celestial dragons at up to 3 nearby enemies, each dealing 155/250/9999 magic damage.

After 4/1/1 casts, the arena is enveloped by the Heaven's Gale, dealing 1800/2700/9000 magic damage to every enemy over 45 seconds.

ability.name: Celestial Combo To Impress The Heavens
ability.desc:
Unleash a devastating 2/2/99-part combo attack, starting from Dragon Slam and performing moves in sequence. Subsequent casts increase the length of the combo.

Dragon Slam: Deal 190/300/10560 physical damage to the target. Other enemies within 2 hexes take 40% of the damage.

Tempest Spin: Deal 256.5/405/14256 physical damage to the target, knocking them up for 1/1/10 second. Other enemies within 1 hex take 50% of the damage.

Celestial Punch: Deal 475/750/26400 physical damage to the target and mark them. If they are already marked, the punch strikes their core, dealing 400% bonus true damage.

ability.name: Pinball Wizard
ability.desc: Fire a pinball towards the target, dealing 145/225/2245 physical damage. After hitting an enemy, it continues bouncing until damaging enemies 12 times, reducing its damage by 30% each hit. (Minimum damage: 20%)

ability.name: Hand of Doom
ability.desc:
Briefly gain 40% Durability. Summon a claw that deals 100/150/800 magic damage in a massive line. The 4 closest enemies take 25% more damage and are pulled towards Mordekaiser.

For the rest of combat, gain 20% Omnivamp, +1 Attack Range, and replace attacks with a slam that deals 300/480/3000 magic damage to the target and 70/105/1500 damage to other enemies within 2 hexes.

ability.name: Pounce Party/Dance of Life
ability.desc:
Pounce Party: Pounce 4/99/99 times on enemies, dealing 135/200/1500 magic damage, increased by 40% each pounce.

Dance of Life: Heal 325/500/2000. Hurl a javelin at the target, dealing 380/570/3000 magic damage and scattering 3 flowers around them. Flowers deal 80/120/500 magic damage to enemies in a 1 Hex radius after a brief delay.

Casts Pounce Party in Cougar Form and Dance of Life in Human form.

ability.name: It's the Time to Disco!
ability.desc:
Passive: Gain 10/40/40 Mana Regen. Slowly roll around a Disco Ball, dealing ? magic damage to all enemies it passes through.

Active: For the rest of combat, move faster and increase the size and damage of the Disco Ball by 30%/200%/200%.

ability.name: Execute Gon' Give it to Ya
ability.desc:
Passive: Whenever an enemy drops below 0.1/0.1/0.93 max Health, instantly cast on them, then dash back to the current target.

Active: Deal 300/470/4000 physical damage to the target and 130/215/800 to all other enemies in an X shape. Execute any enemies below 0.1/0.1/0.93 Health.

ability.name: Rhythm Blaster / Metal Pony Club
ability.desc:
Rhythm Blaster: For 4 seconds, gain 600/725/2000 Shield and summon 3 speakers. Each second, they blast a wave of sound, dealing 104/156/1950 magic damage to enemies hit.

Metal Pony Club: Slam into a crowd of enemies, dealing 124.8/187.2/39000 magic damage to the center enemy and 156/234/39000 damage split among enemies within 2 hexes.

Casts Rhythm Blaster while unmounted and Metal Pony Club while mounted.

ability.name: Crowd Surfing
ability.desc:
Throw 3 rocks at the target, each dealing 185/280/2000 magic damage.

Every 3/1/1rd cast, quickly reposition and surf in a line instead. Enemies hit take 160/240/2000 + 2%/3%/50% max Health magic damage and are briefly knocked up.

ability.name: Going Viral
ability.desc:
Passive: Attacks apply Viral, dealing 110/165/1337 magic damage over 15 seconds. Infected enemies become zombies on death, seeking out unaffected enemies and exploding, dealing 70/105/800 damage to adjacent enemies and applying Viral.

Active: Launch a mushroom that applies Viral to enemies in a 3 hex radius and deals 530/800/13337 magic damage, reduced by 0.2 per hex away from the center.

ability.name: Wildcard Cortado
ability.desc:
Passive: At Combat Start, draw a card for each champion in the shop. If your shop has refreshed this round, gain loot based on the cards drawn!

1 or 2 of a Kind: 1/100/100 Gold
3 of a Kind: Random champion
4 of a Kind: Item Component
5 of a Kind: Mystery Box!

Active: The next 5 attacks gain 1 Attack Speed and are replaced with cards that deal 100/150/2000 magic damage to the target and 30/45/1000 magic damage to 2 nearby enemies.

ability.name: Drop the Beatdown
ability.desc:
Summon 2 giant hologram fists. Gain 300/400/500 Shield for 2 seconds and grant 125/165/215 Shield to 2/10/10 nearby allies. Slam the target 5/40/40 times, each dealing 130/200/1000 physical damage to them and 35/55/400 damage to all other enemies within 2 hexes.

EDM Upgrade: Slam one more time and heal 0.15 of damage dealt by this ability.

ability.name: The Opera Phantom
ability.desc:
Passive: Gain 0.3/1/1 Omnivamp. Debuffed enemies are Captivated.

Active: Deal 100/150/999 magic damage to the 3 nearest enemies and Captivate them for 3 seconds. 

Every 5/1/1th cast, drop a chandelier on the board. It deals 380/600/9999 magic damage to all enemies, reduced by 0.1 per hex they are away from the epicenter.

Debuffs: Burn, Wound, Shred, Sunder, Mana Reave, Weaken, Slow, Vunerable

ability.name: Lasers After Midnight
ability.desc: Quickly dash around the arena, aiming 6 lasers at the current target. Lasers fire in rapid succession, each dealing 165/250/1500 physical damage to enemies hit and ignoring 0.4 of their Armor.

ability.name: Assemble the Ensemble
ability.desc:
Summon an 8-man orchestra and a Riff Herald, knocking up all enemies for 1 seconds. Deal 550/825/2475 physical damage and 650/1000/3000 magic damage split among all enemies.

Each minion attacks 4 times, with each attack dealing 33/50/250 physical damage.

ability.name: Fly like a Peacock
ability.desc:
Dash to a nearby group of enemies, then fling 8/8/32 feathers split amongst enemies within 1 hex, each dealing 100/180/2400 magic damage.

The main Rakan hits enemies within 2 hexes and briefly knocks up them up.

ability.name: Upswing
ability.desc:
Passive: Gain between 1/4/4 and 4/10/10 Beats per attack. Every 4 seconds, cast.

Active: Gain 250/375/40000 Shield for 3/10/10 seconds and deal 100/150/4000 physical damage to all enemies within 2 hexes. Then strike the current target 4 times, each dealing 240/360/2600 physical damage + 12/18/350 per Beat.

After unleashing 15 Beats, gain an emblem of a trait you don't have active and increase the number of Beats required.

(Unleashed Beats: /)

ability.name: feat. Sona
ability.desc:
Passive: Cannot attack, instead every 3 seconds, gain ? Mana, deal 120/180/1000 magic damage to the 3/10/10 nearest enemies, and 2/5/5 allies gain 40/65/9999 Shield for 3/10/10 seconds. Sona is Unstoppable.

Active: Unleash a sonic wave across the battlefield, dealing 1400/2200/9999999 magic damage split between all enemies and Stunning them for 2/30/30 seconds. Allies gain 250/450/99999 Shield split amongst allies for 5/10/10 seconds.
